context: Cycle plot (small multiples) showing U.S. Monthly Retail Sales 2020-2024, one panel per month with year-over-year trends, mean lines, and annotations
first_impression: Deliberately designed with a sequential Tol blue palette, purposeful magenta accents, and story-telling annotations that elevate it well above generic AI-generated chart defaults.
what_works: Sequential blues communicating year progression is intentional and accessibility-conscious; annotated extremes (High/Low), COVID dip callout, and holiday season bracket together tell a coherent story without cluttering the data.
what_doesnt: Mean value labels at 8px are cramped right at panel boundaries and hard to read cleanly at this size; the rendered SVG has a large empty white region below the chart occupying roughly the bottom 40% of the viewport, making the layout feel unfinished.
